_note: The village post office by the farm road (data/maps/town.json, door 1, 9): one room split by a long counter. In front, an earth floor for callers; behind the counter, the pigeonholes where Ren sorts the morning bag, his chest and the futon he rolls out at night; a lamp and sacks of parcels in front by the wall. Format: README.md, Maps. The daruma the farmer gives Ren stands on his chest once given (kept_ren_daruma).
